name_reason: Compliant with fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. '14' is the per-event handler table slot index idx 0x14 (confirmed: table entry @ 0x51be1 holds little-endian bytes b1470300 = 0x000347b1, this function's own address), a domain ID not an address residue. 'ch6' = chapter 6 (valid chapter domain ID 06). 'dialog' = category (dialog-only). Matches all sibling handler names in chevt1.c; accurately reflects purpose and body.
purpose: Chapter 6 turn-event slot 0 (turn 5 / phase 2): the minimal dialog-only beat -- show dialog page 1, no other side effects.
logic_summary: Single straight-line call: fd2_display_dialog_scene(data_fd2_current_chapter_text, page=1, 0xA0000, 0x140, 0xCD, 0x4C, 0x4A, 0x13, 1). No branches, no RNG, no numeric computation; the dialog return value is discarded; event_arg is never read. In the original binary it pushes its 8 args then JMP 0x3452F into handler_09's shared tail (PUSH data_fd2_current_chapter_text; CALL fd2_display_dialog_scene; ADD ESP,0x24; RET); src inlines the call for Layer-2 equivalence. __CHK(0x28) stack-probe prologue is compiler-injected.
